notes: stator_mass_kg applies to the bearing_* tests (stator with bearing insert installed); tare_stator_mass_kg applies to the tare_* tests (bearing insert removed).

channels.force_x_N: shaker force applied to the stator in +x, newtons
channels.force_y_N: shaker force applied to the stator in +y, newtons
channels.accel_x_g: absolute stator acceleration in +x, units of g
channels.accel_y_g: absolute stator acceleration in +y, units of g
channels.disp_x_um: stator-minus-rotor relative displacement in +x from proximity probes, micrometres
channels.disp_y_um: stator-minus-rotor relative displacement in +y from proximity probes, micrometres
